ResearchProjectDef.label: sleeper crossings
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cryptosleep caskets rigged for decades of drift: a cheap ship can cross to a star a few light-years away while the crew sleeps through the years.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bar route charts
ResearchProjectDef.description: Charts of the dense, well-traveled lanes inside a galactic bar. Warp jumps between two bar stars cost half the matter, reach twice as far and take half the time.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hyperlane navigation
ResearchProjectDef.description: How to force a capital ship into the fixed hyperlanes of the rare galaxies that have them, and ride them without fuel.

ResearchProjectDef.label: frame bracing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Internal bracing that keeps a shattered hull in one piece longer. Ships only start to break apart at 5% integrity instead of 10%.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deep sensor analysis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Better processing of faint sensor returns. Your sensors read the size class of star systems at twice their normal reach.

ResearchProjectDef.label: salvage operations
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cutting crews and sorting drones for beaten ships. Wrecks left after a space battle give half again as much material.

ResearchProjectDef.label: radiation shielding
ResearchProjectDef.description: Layered shielding in suits and the habit of checking dosimeters. Colonists resist an extra 20% of radiation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: habitat sealing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Seals, airlocks and pressure doors for buildings on hostile worlds. Any closed, roofed room with a working air generator holds breathable air, not just ship rooms.

ResearchProjectDef.label: AI governance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Protocols that let an AI persona core run a colony: steadier stability, less attention from raiders, flawless paperwork.

ResearchProjectDef.label: megastructure logistics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Supply chains measured in millions of tons. Each megastructure stage costs a quarter less.

ResearchProjectDef.label: interstellar banking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Accounts with the banks of star civilizations, at their trade terminals. Deposits earn interest, and you can change between silver, orbital credits, stellar marks, sector crowns and the galactic standard.

ResearchProjectDef.label: orbital trade docking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cargo transfer rules for docked traders. With a docking port or a trade terminal, you can sell goods from your holds and storage without an orbital trade beacon.

ResearchProjectDef.label: market analytics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Price feeds from star markets. The bank window shows what each civilization pays more or less for, so you know where to sell.
